description: Store the RevenueCat provider app id and encrypted authorization secret for an app, and optionally the webhook signing secret (omitted, the stored one is kept).

authorization_secret.description: The Authorization header value set on the AttriKit webhook in RevenueCat's dashboard, 16 to 1,024 characters. Stored encrypted.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

provider_app_id.description: RevenueCat's PROJECT app id from their dashboard app settings, not the SDK key.

signing_secret.description: RevenueCat's HMAC signing secret, for the X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature header. Optional: omitted, the stored one is kept.

name: configure_revenuecat
title: Configure RevenueCat
